title: Jesus... I Turned My Hope Off So It Can't Hurt Me. 🛡️
topic: he switched his hope off after too many letdowns and now protects himself by expecting nothing, so hoping again feels like a setup

bible.text: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I turned my hope off so it couldn't hurt me again. 🛡️

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: No big dreams. No countdowns. Nothing expected, nothing lost.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You call that peace. I call it a room with no windows.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Every time I hoped big, I paid for it. Hope keeps sending me the bill.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: The blessed hope isn't another thing that might not come. It's Me, already promised. Outcomes change. I don't.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You can't protect your heart by starving it. Feed it something certain.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the friend who stopped dreaming out loud. 💭
